changelog: Added `AI_TROUBLESHOOTING.md` and `docs/ai/` so operators can load a structured English guide into an AI assistant for VoxyWatch configuration, troubleshooting
Settings -> Diagnostics now includes compact actions to open AI docs, copy/download an AI-safe context and download the support bundle.
changelog_es: Se agregó `AI_TROUBLESHOOTING.md` y `docs/ai/` con guía en inglés para que una IA ayude a configurar, diagnosticar y extender VoxyWatch sin depender de ticke
Settings → Diagnóstico ahora ofrece accesos compactos para abrir docs IA, copiar/descargar contexto IA seguro y descargar el support bundle.
